purpose: Verify an isothermal reinforced slab fiber SECTION after tensile cracking, including cycles and energy. No panel integration, global capacity or predetermined collapse outcome.

section.quadrature: Equal midpoint fibers through depth; steel layers are distinct integration points. Concrete area is uniformly reduced by total steel ratio, so Ac+As=Ag. This smeared area replacement is an explicit geometric approximation, not the actual bar holes.
section.kinematics: Small-strain plane section: eps(y)=eps0-y*kappa, y positive upward. N=sum(A*sigma), M=-sum(A*y*sigma). Virtual work per unit longitudinal length is N*d(eps0)+M*d(kappa).
section.geometry_status: Reuse V11A/V11D equivalent strip, NOT an as-built reinforced/deck section. No topping/deck/chord/rebar double-counting or truss stiffness added.

concrete.law: Compression linear elastic until the fc domain screen; tension elastic then linear softening to zero. Irreversible max tensile strain, secant unloading to origin, restored elastic compression at closure. No crack healing or compression plasticity.
concrete.regularization: eps0=ft/E; epsf=2*Gf/(ft*Lch), require epsf>eps0. Total monotonic work per volume is Gf/Lch including the pre-peak triangle. Lch is longitudinal crack-band length, NOT slab depth or fiber thickness. No tensile residual stress floor.
concrete.status: E/fc/ft inherited hypotheses; Gf/Lch new uncalibrated sensitivity hypotheses. No measured WTC tensile fracture curve, cycle law or crushing law.

reinforcement.law: Symmetric elastic-perfectly plastic, associative 1D return mapping; no hardening, buckling, fatigue, rupture or rate effect. Perfect steel-concrete strain compatibility.
reinforcement.status: All steel areas, grade and layer placement are EXPLORATORY assumptions, not an actual WTC reinforcement schedule. The 1 percent strain screen is a chosen model domain, not measured fracture strain.

paths.control: Prescribed curvature, imposed constant axial force (usually N=0). Enumerate the exact piecewise-linear axial equation; require one positive axial tangent root. Multiple positive roots or absence of one stops as unresolved, not collapse. Neutral zero-stiffness alternatives are counted separately. Trial calls never commit state.
paths.stop: First concrete compression fc at either actual outer face of the equivalent strip (exact linear compressive strain recovery), or chosen steel strain domain screen, not tensile cracking/yield. Locate domain boundary by bisection from previous committed state. No compression continuation or floor failure inferred.

method_sources.scope: Primary software manual: linear total-strain tensile softening can be parameterized by tensile strength, fracture energy and crack bandwidth. Not WTC material calibration, and DIANA is not run.
Primary software manual, section74.2: distinguishes cracking, secant unloading and elastic compression after closure. V11E is an explicit 1D simplification, not the whole DIANA constitutive model.
Primary software manual: uniaxial elastic-perfectly plastic law. Own transparent implementation; no OpenSees executable or cross-solver validation claimed.
